tournament.name: South America Magic Series - Regional Championship - Final

decks.notes: This deck is focused on aggressive gameplay, aiming to win the game quickly. It utilizes a combination of powerful creatures and burn spells to deal damage to the opponent's life total. Key cards include Kari Zev, Skyship Raider, Hazoret the Fervent, and Kumano Faces Kakkazan for creature aggression. Additionally, Lightning Strike, Play with Fire, Spikefield Hazard, and Shatterskull Smashing provide removal and direct damage spells. The deck also includes land cards like Ramunap Ruins and Castle Embereth to boost damage output. The overall strategy revolves around consistently dealing damage and overwhelming the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategies through a combination of counter spells, removal, and card advantage. Utilizing cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Notion Thief to limit the opponent's card draw, while also using Fatal Push and Ritual of Soot to remove threats from the board. The deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent in the long run, with a mix of control elements and card advantage engines like Dig Through Time and Day's Undoing.

Utilize a variety of enchantments and creatures to control the battlefield and generate value through Enigmatic Incarnation. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a powerful companion to provide additional card advantage and flexibility. The deck includes a mix of removal, card draw, and threats to maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's diverse color requirements and ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, the strategy revolves around leveraging Enigmatic Incarnation to continuously trade up in resources and outvalue the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan, while pressuring them with aggressive creatures. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Unlucky Witness, the deck can deal damage and trigger abilities like Mayhem Devil. The inclusion of cards like Claim the Firstborn and Village Rites allows for additional flexibility in the deck's game plan. The mana base is carefully designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy and ensure consistent casting of cards.

The deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to sacrifice creatures and search for specific creatures or enchantments from the deck. It aims to control the board by utilizing various disruptive creatures and removal spells to maintain dominance. The deck also utilizes Fires of Invention to cast multiple spells per turn and overwhelm the opponent. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion to provide additional value and card advantage. The deck aims to lock down the opponent's options and win the game through incremental advantage and powerful creature plays.

This Gruul aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and using powerful spells to control the board and deal damage to the opponent. With a strong mana base and efficient creatures like Lovestruck Beast and Bonecrusher Giant, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed and power. The inclusion of powerful cards like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot provide additional value and versatility to help maintain pressure on the opponent. Overall, this deck is designed to be fast and resilient, aiming to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push while applying pressure with creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also utilizes powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to maintain board presence and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The mana base provides the necessary resources to consistently cast spells and keep the pressure on the opponent.

The main concept behind this deck is to utilize Azorius spirits to aggressively control the tempo of the game. By playing low-cost creatures such as Supreme Phantom and Rattlechains, the deck can quickly build a board presence while disrupting the opponent with cards like Shacklegeist and Geistlight Snare. The inclusion of cards like Curious Obsession and Otawara, Soaring City allow for additional card draw and evasion, while Faceless Haven provides a resilient threat. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

This Boros aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and combat tricks to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Favored Hoplite and Monastery Swiftspear, paired with combat manipulation spells like Gods Willing and Invigorated Rampage, this deck aims to deal damage swiftly and efficiently. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck's gameplay. With a solid mana base and strategic creature choices, this deck aims to push for victory through quick, aggressive plays.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on utilizing early mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to ramp into powerful threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast. The deck also includes aggressive creatures like Reckless Stormseeker and efficient removal spells like Obliterating Bolt to maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional ramp and flexibility. Additionally, cards like Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provide additional value and board presence to overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to quickly establish a dominant board state and close out games efficiently.

The key concept of this deck is to leverage the synergy and aggression of Human creatures. The deck focuses on building a board presence and overwhelming the opponent with a combination of early aggression and disruptive effects. The inclusion of Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant enhances the deck's ability to slow down the opponent and pump up its own creatures. The deck also incorporates Collected Company to find additional creatures and keep the pressure up. Overall, this deck aims to establish dominance on the battlefield through the strength of its Human creatures.

The main strategy of this deck is to use sacrificial effects and creatures to gain incremental advantages while dealing damage to the opponent. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Unlucky Witness with Witch's Oven and Deadly Dispute, the player can trigger abilities like Mayhem Devil's ping ability and create a loop of sacrificing and recurring creatures. Claim the Firstborn can also steal the opponent's creatures, further increasing the pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to control the board while chipping away at the opponent's life total to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to maintain control of the game through counter spells, removal, and card draw until you can establish a win condition. Using cards like Absorb, Supreme Verdict, and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, you aim to control the board while drawing into powerful finishers like Shark Typhoon. The deck also includes lands that support the control strategy, such as Castle Vantress for card selection and Field of Ruin for dealing with troublesome lands. Overall, the key idea is to stall and control the game until you can secure a victory.

The main strategy of this UW Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering their spells, removing their threats, and drawing cards to gain card advantage. The deck focuses on controlling the board with counterspells like Absorb and Dovin's Veto, removal spells like Fateful Absence and Supreme Verdict, and card draw engines like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The deck also includes win conditions like Shark Typhoon and The Wandering Emperor to close out the game once the opponent has been sufficiently controlled. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's strategies and ensure consistent casting of spells.

This deck focuses on quickly building a strong board presence of small, aggressive white creatures known as "Weenies." By utilizing efficient creatures like Kytheon, Hero of Akros and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, along with cards like Brave the Elements to protect your creatures, the strategy is to overwhelm your opponent with a swarm of creatures and go for a fast victory. Cards like Luminarch Aspirant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar can quickly pump up your creatures to make them even more threatening. Using lands like Castle Ardenvale and Mutavault to help maintain your board presence is crucial in this aggressive strategy.

This Weenie White Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost creatures such as Thalia's Lieutenant, Luminarch Aspirant, and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, while also protecting them with cards like Brave the Elements. With a mix of aggressive creatures and anthem effects, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game and maintain pressure throughout. The deck also utilizes utility lands like Castle Ardenvale and Mutavault to provide additional value and flexibility in combat.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while using card advantage and efficient removal spells to control the game. The deck utilizes cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Notion Thief to limit the opponent's resources, while also having access to counterspells like Spell Pierce and Censor. Ritual of Soot and Fatal Push are used for creature removal, while Dig Through Time helps to dig for key cards. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can win with a powerful threat like Shark Typhoon.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using Fires of Invention to cast powerful spells for free. It utilizes a mix of removal spells, powerful creatures like Omnath and Kenrith, and card advantage engines like Skyclave Apparition and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to dominate the battlefield. The companion Keruga, the Macrosage provides additional card draw and a bigger hand size. The deck aims to lock down the opponent's resources while generating value and eventually overwhelming them with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on using Fires of Invention to effectively control the board while utilizing powerful creatures like Omnath and Kenrith to quickly end the game. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Temporary Lockdown further solidify the control aspect of the deck, while Cavalier of Flame provides an additional win condition. The deck also includes various lands to ensure mana consistency and flexibility. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently managing resources and controlling the pace of the game to secure victory.

The Gruul Aggro deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent quickly with efficient creatures like Lovestruck Beast and Reckless Stormseeker, while also utilizing powerful cards like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot to maintain board control. The deck also includes removal spells like Obliterating Bolt and The Akroan War to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, the use of lands like Den of the Bugbear and Lair of the Hydra ensures a steady stream of mana to keep up the aggression.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly developing a strong board presence through efficient and aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast. It also utilizes powerful vehicles like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes removal spells like Obliterating Bolt and The Akroan War to control the board and protect its threats. Additionally, the deck has mana acceleration from cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to ramp up and play its threats ahead of schedule.

This deck focuses on using Lotus Field as a key component in a combo strategy to generate large amounts of mana and facilitate powerful plays. The deck includes cards that can untap Lotus Field, search for combo pieces, and draw additional cards to find key pieces. The goal is to assemble a winning combination of cards through manipulating mana and synergistic effects, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a powerful sequence of plays. The deck aims to quickly set up its combo and win the game before the opponent can respond effectively.

The deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to draw multiple cards and gain incremental advantage, while controlling the board with removal spells like Abrupt Decay and Vanishing Verse. The deck also includes a toolbox of powerful multicolored cards like Bring to Light and Leyline Binding to answer a variety of threats. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's five-color requirements, allowing for flexibility in casting spells of any color. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana ramp and consistency to fuel the deck's game plan.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board while aggressively deploying powerful threats like Kroxa and Sheoldred to quickly finish off opponents. The deck also includes graveyard recursion and token generation to maintain card advantage and overwhelm opponents. With a mix of removal, hand disruption, and efficient creatures, this deck aims to apply pressure from multiple angles, punishing opponents for slow starts and giving the pilot a strong chance of achieving victory in the early-to-mid game.

The key concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively play threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, Bonecrusher Giant, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to pressure the opponent. The deck also utilizes discard spells like Thoughseize and removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent while utilizing its mana base efficiently with lands like Blood Crypt and Haunted Ridge.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggression and disruption, utilizing powerful creatures like Kroxa and Sheoldred to apply pressure on the opponent. Misery's Shadow and Graveyard Trespasser help to control the board while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides card advantage. Removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill keep the opponent's creatures in check, allowing the player to maintain dominance. The deck also features land destruction with cards like Dreadbore and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies, aiming to quickly deal damage to the opponent and control the board with removal spells. The key concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's plans with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize, while developing a strong board presence with powerful creatures like Kroxa and Bonecrusher Giant. Utilizing a mix of graveyard recursion and direct damage, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

The focus of this UW Control deck is to maintain control of the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck includes a variety of counterspells such as Dovin's Veto and Absorb, along with removal spells like Settle the Wreckage and Supreme Verdict. Card draw and selection are provided by cards like Behold the Multiverse and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck also includes win conditions in the form of Shark Typhoon and The Wandering Emperor. The mana base is designed to support the control elements with utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Vantress.

This UW Control deck focuses on countering and controlling the opponent's plays while generating card advantage with cards like Behold the Multiverse and Memory Deluge. The deck includes board wipes like Supreme Verdict to deal with threats, along with versatile threats like Shark Typhoon and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The mana base is constructed to support the deck's control elements, with utility lands like Field of Ruin and Hengegate Pathway. With a mix of counterspells, removal, and card draw, this deck aims to out-value and outlast the opponent in a long game.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats from the board, and generating card advantage. Using cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and The Wandering Emperor, along with efficient removal spells like Detention Sphere and Portable Hole, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and outvalue the opponent. By utilizing a mix of counter spells, removal, and powerful planeswalkers, the deck seeks to establish dominance and win through attrition.

The deck focuses on quickly summoning a swarm of low-cost, aggressive white creatures to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards that boost each other's power and provide protection, the deck aims to maintain a strong board presence and constantly apply pressure to the opponent. In addition, the inclusion of powerful legendaries like Kytheon and Skyclave Apparition adds versatility and disruption to the strategy, ensuring that the deck remains competitive and difficult to counter. By efficiently utilizing mana and creature synergies, the deck aims to secure victory through a relentless onslaught of creatures.

The deck focuses on aggressive, low-cost creatures that can quickly overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient playstyle. The key strategy is to maintain a steady stream of small, powerful creatures on the battlefield, growing their strength and numbers with cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Luminarch Aspirant. The inclusion of Brave the Elements helps protect the creatures from removal spells and allows for strategic attacks. With a strong mana base and support cards like Castle Ardenvale, the deck aims to maintain pressure and control the game tempo from the start.
